definition: Seconds from the nearest LBMA Silver Price auction, at 12:00 London time on London weekdays, negative before it and positive after.
boundaries: London time follows its daylight-saving rule. UK bank holidays are not modelled. Bars without a time are missing. QML's unit runtime passes each bar its close time, so inside a unit this value reads from the first bar. As a lone slot binding it holds nothing: bind value-above to it to gate on the seconds.
recognition: A silver unit stands aside around the noon auction.

golden.reference: local event times from zoneinfo (the IANA tz database), in qml/tests/golden/beyond-fx/reference_run.py
